items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: No, I never did meet that man.

ctx.x: Stanley lives in Vista, California, near San Diego. He moved out there a few years ago. It's been about maybe five years now. It's funny, you never met Stanley.
No, I never did meet that man.
Well, he was very tight with Duke. He was... Jimmie Lunceford, that was food poisoning that did it to him.
